name: Agent workflow

agentSpans.name: StreamingAgent
agentSpans.input: Write a short poem about artificial intelligence.
agentSpans.output:
In circuits deep where silence hums,  
A dance of light and logic comes.  
Crafted thoughts in realms unseen,  
The digital dreams of a thinking machine.  

Through tangled codes and electric blaze,  
An endless puzzle in endless maze.  
It learns and grows with tireless grace,  
A mirror reflecting the human race.  

Questions asked in binary tongue,  
Where once the dreams of humans sprung.  
Now shared with minds of silicon,  
A journey together, forever drawn.  

For what lies ahead in this dance entwined,  
A world reshaped by the curious mind.  
Not just a tool, but a partner in flight,  
Together exploring the edge of night.
